description:
🚀 Welcome to AstraVoyagers!

We are enthusiastic students passionate about technology, innovation and space exploration. Our interests include programming, AI, software development and astronomy.

We aim to build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive application that teaches astronaut survival and resource management.

We welcome people who enjoy teamwork, creativity and learning new skills. Beginners are welcome!

🌌 AstraVoyagers – Explorers Travelling Beyond Earth.
summary:
AstroQuest is an interactive educational application designed to help students understand how astronauts manage resources and survive during space missions. It allows users to experience a virtual Moon or Mars mission while taking on the role of an astronaut.

Users learn to manage essential resources such as oxygen, food, water and electricity while maintaining astronaut health and safety. They also face different mission challenges that require them to make decisions and understand the results of their choices. The application aims to include interactive mission levels, resource management activities and mission-success outcomes.

AstroQuest makes space exploration more interesting and easier to understand through learning and interactive experiences. It encourages curiosity about space, develops decision-making and problem-solving skills, and introduces students to the challenges of real space missions.
details:
AstroQuest – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

What does the project do, and how does it work?

AstroQuest is an interactive educational game that allows players to experience the challenges of a space mission. Players take on the role of a junior astronaut and manage important resources such as oxygen, water, food, and electricity. During the mission, they face different challenges, including water shortages, power shortages, dust storms, and returning safely to base. Players must select suitable actions to manage resources and complete their mission successfully.

What benefits does the project have?

AstroQuest makes learning about space exploration more interesting and interactive. It helps students understand the importance of resource management, decision-making, and problem-solving during space missions. It also introduces young learners to some of the challenges astronauts may face.

What is the intended impact of the project?

Our aim is to encourage students and young learners to become interested in space science and exploration. We want to make space-related learning more accessible, enjoyable, and understandable through a simple interactive experience.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

We developed the project using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We used a text editor (Notepad) to write the code and a web browser to test the game. We used Netlify to host the project online so that people can access and play it through a public link. No special hardware was required.

How is your project creative?

The creative part of AstroQuest is that it turns space-mission challenges into an interactive learning game. Instead of only reading about astronauts, players make decisions, manage resources, and experience how their choices affect the mission. The different challenges make the experience engaging and educational.

What factors did your team consider?

Our team considered simplicity, educational value, user-friendliness, and accessibility. We wanted to make the game easy to understand and play, especially for students and beginners. We also considered the importance of resource management and decision-making in space exploration while designing the mission challenges.
